installCommand: (command -v unzip >/dev/null || dnf install -y unzip) && if [ -d .flutter-sdk ]; then git -C .flutter-sdk pull --ff-only; else git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git --branch stable --depth 1 .flutter-sdk; fi && .flutter-sdk/bin/flutter --version
buildCommand: touch .env && .flutter-sdk/bin/flutter config --enable-web --no-analytics && .flutter-sdk/bin/flutter pub get && .flutter-sdk/bin/flutter build web --release --dart-define=SUPABASE_URL=$SUPABASE_URL --dart-define=SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=$SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
